why: The scaffold pins dashboard-v3 to the G2 floor, but routes that consume charts GA (every chart route) need layers frozen later. No route Issue owns the pin, and the managed layer must be re-rendered at the same version.
what: The basalt-ui pin in apps/dashboard-v3/package.json raised from floors.G3.next to floors.G4.next, the lockfile and the re-rendered managed layer. Nothing else.
must_not_touch: application source (a break in ported code is fixed here only when `basalt-ui migrate` rows apply it mechanically; else stop and report a `friction:` line)
contract: Read ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/scripts/fleet.json: `floors.G4.next` is the exact version (3.0.0-next.N). Pins stay exact. Raised only after v3-freeze-g4. The old app and the root keep their 2.x install.
exemplar: The repo's previous bump commit (`git log --oneline -- bun.lock | head`) for message shape.
change: Set `basalt-ui` in apps/dashboard-v3/package.json to the floors.G4.next value, `bun install`, run the app bin `sync` and `doctor`, compare `lint --stats` waiver counts before and after. Commit 1: package.json and bun.lock. Commit 2 (only if files change): the re-rendered managed layer. Rule: doctor and lint pass. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: `make check`; no deploy proof is claimed for a pin on an app nothing links to yet.
acceptance: `bun install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0; `rg -n 'basalt-ui@' bun.lock` shows the old 2.x pin and the new next.N only
app bin `doctor` and `sync --check` exit 0; `lint --stats` waiver count is not higher
`git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD` lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: Application code, other dependencies, the root install, routes.
